hook: Cool, hazy week ahead: outskirts dip to *12-16°C*
hook_b: Cool, hazy week ahead: outskirts dip to *12-16°C*
tldr: While Cyclone Akvan keeps coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha on alert, IMD Hyderabad forecasts a partly cloudy, hazy sky for the city till Nov 25. Dry northerly winds keep humidity low; eastern Telangana districts may see thunderstorms and isolated heavy rain.

beats.what: IMD Hyderabad's seven-day forecast shows a partly cloudy sky with haze for the city till November 25.
beats.why: Dry, cold northerly winds are keeping daytime humidity low and pulling night temperatures down in western and northern Telangana.
beats.care: Early mornings in Rajendranagar, Patancheru and nearby districts are in the 12-16°C range; days in core Hyderabad stay around 30-31°C.
